title: Intra-city particulate elemental characteristics and variabilities in Jakarta
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00059A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Driejana, Novi Kartika Sari, Muhayatun Santoso, Dyah Dwiana Lestiani
Elemental composition measurements and wind profiles at multiple sites in the north–south transect in Jakarta have uncovered distinctive sources of particulates that can be used to formulate targeted control policies.
